description: Use this when you are about to send an EVM transaction and need current gas prices, or want the cheapest chain right now. Live gas tracker across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon and BNB Chain: head block age, base fee, 10th/50th/90th percentile priority fees from eth_feeHistory, suggested maxFeePerGas tiers, and estimated cost of a native transfer and an ERC-20 transfer. Read-only. Returns JSON with: timestamp, chains, cheapestEthTransfer, method, source. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/evm-gas
name: evm_gas
title: Evm Gas
